page: Microsoft Azure D4nlds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the Dnldv6 server family. It is equipped with 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server type includes 236 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is premium storage capable. It is designated as a network-optimized instance, prioritizing network throughput. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration, and it does not feature any GPU hardware.

The low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:2 represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing compute power and network performance over memory capacity. This makes the instance cost-efficient for workloads that require dedicated CPU resources and fast local storage but do not demand large memory footprints. Suitable workloads include network appliances, web serving, light database tasks, and distributed systems where local NVMe storage and network optimization are critical.
